title: Rhinitis Medicamentosa —
If You've Used Decongestant Spray
Every Day for Over a Week, Check This Now
Breaking the Rebound Cycle for Good

items.name: Why your nose stops responding to the spray
body: Push past three to five days
the same way — swelling snaps back
harder the moment the drug wears off

items.name: Quitting outright
body: That spike alone sends most people
before their nose gets a chance to reset

items.name: Switch to a steroid spray instead
body: Starting one before your last dose

items.name: Still stuck after weeks of tapering?

headline: Talk to your doctor about
a steroid spray first —
there are more options
than most people realize
tip: Brace for a rough few days once you stop the decongestant — that congestion spike is temporary, not a sign it's not working
Don't assume you're stuck if tapering alone doesn't work — in-office procedures exist specifically for long-term users
